charge_port.notes: Genesis USA: NACS only from the 2026 model year; 2023-2025 models have CCS ports (CCS1 in North America).
Estimated: Genesis Canada page names only the GV60 and GV70; the Canadian G80 is assumed CCS1 like the US car (the Canadian 2025 car is not proven).

supercharger_access.notes: US: Genesis says 2023-2025 CCS models need an external adapter for Tesla Superchargers; Genesis ships a free NACS-to-CCS adapter to eligible owners (InsideEVs).
Estimated: Genesis Canada announced Supercharger access via an adapter from Q1 2025 for Genesis EVs with CCS ports; the page names the GV60 and Electrified GV70 only, so the G80 is inferred.
